title: cc-smith storybook: every case
intro: Nine steps an Indian credit-card holder takes in cc-smith, each with its normal path, edge cases and failures. Every screen sits next to the calls made behind it, from the app to the backend, the rewards engine, the card-facts store, the ledger and SerpApi. Figures come from the backend's tests and one recorded user: HDFC Millennia on a shared HDFC limit and HSBC Live+ in its free first year, spending ₹59,000 a month.
rolloutLede: Hackathon submission first (10 Oct, 18:00 IST), then the three-month plan.
